acceptanceCriteria: A conftest.py change selects every test under its directory, or produces a named frontier.
Tests cover conftest and plugin edges.
body: Residual of lane PR beamfall/corvint#1469 (affected-1021n, seal 6c411fe85, base ef2a01db5). Expected: a change to a conftest.py or a pytest plugin module selects the tests it applies to. Actual: the Python adapter in internal/liveverify/affected/python does not model these edges, so such changes select too little or fall to the frontier without a named reason.

title: affected Python adapter: conftest.py and pytest plugin edges are not modelled
